$$
-1.5^{\circ} \, \textrm{C} - 3.5^{\circ} \, \textrm{C} = -5.0^{\circ} \, \textrm{C}.
$$

$$
-5.0^{\circ} \, \textrm{C} + 2.6^{\circ} \, \textrm{C} = -2.4^{\circ} \, \textrm{C}.
$$

$$
